WITH project_rates AS (
  SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM project_rates
)
SELECT pr.arcref, pr.fundflux, pr.rate, pr.rate - b.avg_rate AS gap_above_benchmark
FROM project_rates AS pr
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE pr.rate > b.avg_rate
ORDER BY gap_above_benchmark DESC
LIMIT 10;
